easy.def: An instrument with bars that you hit with sticks.
examples: I play a song on the xylophone.
The xylophone has bars of many colors.
He hit the xylophone with a stick.

more.def: A musical instrument with a row of bars that you strike with small mallets.
examples: She played a cheerful tune on the xylophone in music class.
The band has a xylophone player.
The xylophone's wooden bars each make a different note.

easy.def: A person who plays the xylophone.
examples: A xylophonist hits bars with mallets.

more.def: A musician who plays the xylophone, an instrument with wooden bars that are struck with mallets.
examples: The xylophonist played a bright tune.
A xylophonist uses two or four mallets.
The xylophonist in our band is very good.
